model_annotation: The figure presents training dynamics for several models, comparing on-policy RL and off-policy reasoning traces. The x-axis represents training steps, displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels spaced every 50 steps. The y-axis indicates training rewards, also on a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 1, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1. The first plot illustrates the training dynamics of LUFIFY, where initially regarding primary imitation off-policy trajectories, as indicated by the increasing generation length gradually aligning with the initial reasoning dice (depicted by an average step-length limitation of approximately 53 steps), after which, model rewards and policies demonstrate more prominent, collapsing independent exploration while learning to retain policy selectivity, before more reward signals are generated. The second plot depicts the training rewards of LLaMA-3.1B on the Easy and Hard training sets, displaying a linear scale extending from 0 to 1 with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1. The third plot shows the training rewards of LLaMA-3.1B-Hard, presenting a linear scale extending from 0 to 1 with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1.
